The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Veneb Drassk]] led a '''clan''' of Trandoshans during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], teaching them to abandon the teachings of the [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]] and pursue self-interest. Drassk eliminated his rivals through a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Gwarror]], and the older Trandoshan hunter [[Qyzen Fess]] discovered this and issued a ''[[ghrajath]]'' against Drassk to halt his plans to become [[Clan Speaker]]. Drassk attacked Fess and the hunter's companion, the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]], at their meeting on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], but was [[Death/Legends|slain]]. Afterwards, Fess was convinced by the Barsen'thor and the younger Trandoshans of Drassk's clan to assume leadership of the clan and to teach them the ways of the Scorekeeper.
